title: Vampire Vape Shortz Watermelon Mojito
description: Pure fruity, refreshing bliss is the signature sensation of this irresistible e-liquid from Vampire Vape’s Shortz collection. The fresh, ripe, juicy flavour of Watermelons drench your tastebuds on the inhale, followed by the cool, delicate mint that rides on the exhale. Perfectly balanced, utterly refreshing and absolutely moreish, this fruity mojito ticks every box. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
